project_type: Cross-platform desktop app: Tauri 2 (Rust core) + React 18 + TypeScript + Vite frontend. Multi-crate Cargo workspace under hybrid-orchestrator/; frontend under hybrid-orchestrator/frontend/.
build_system: Cargo virtual workspace (crates are [workspace] members but CI verifies per-manifest). npm + Vite for frontend. Tauri CLI is NOT available offline. rustfmt.toml: edition 2021, max_width 100.
test_framework: Rust: cargo test per crate (unit tests inline in #[cfg(test)] mods; tauri-app has tests/restart_survival.rs). Frontend: vitest + @testing-library/react (jsdom), test-setup.ts, *.test.tsx / *.test.ts colocated.
build_command: Frontend: from hybrid-orchestrator/frontend run `npm run build` (tsc && vite build). Rust per touched crate: `cargo build --manifest-path crates/<crate>/Cargo.toml`. NOTE: offline (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY) crates.io/npm are 403 and node_modules cannot be installed, so full build/test only runs in CI.
test_command: Frontend: `npm run test` (vitest run) from hybrid-orchestrator/frontend. Rust: `cargo test --manifest-path crates/<crate>/Cargo.toml`. Both only runnable in CI offline.
verification_instructions: OFFLINE self-checks that MUST pass before finishing (these are runnable): (1) for EVERY Rust crate touched, `cargo fmt --manifest-path crates/<crate>/Cargo.toml --check`; (2) from hybrid-orchestrator/frontend, `NODE_OPTIONS= npx prettier --check .` (global prettier). Self-audit clippy -D warnings and eslint/tsc/vitest by inspection since they cannot run offline. CI (ubuntu+windows) runs per-crate cargo fmt/build/clippy/test + frontend npm install/lint/format:check/vitest and is the authoritative gate.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Tauri raster app icons under crates/tauri-app/icons/ are generated from a raster source via `cargo tauri icon path/to/logo.png`. Tauri CLI is NOT available offline, so raster regeneration is a documented follow-up; leave existing placeholder rasters in place so tauri.conf.json stays valid and the build stays green. Do NOT commit broken/empty icon files. sqlx migrations in crates/persistence/migrations/ are applied at runtime (idempotent, recorded in _sqlx_migrations); a NEW migration file is additive.
setup_instructions: Repo already cloned at /projects/agent-harbor on branch main at origin tip. Create a NEW branch `phase-7-ux-refactor` off main before editing. Do NOT push or open a PR (orchestrator handles that). Frontend deps already declared in package.json; no new runtime deps should be added (no heavy UI library).
environment_constraints: Network INTEGRATIONS_ONLY: no crates.io/npm/registry access, node_modules cannot be installed, Tauri CLI absent, no Docker for this project. Therefore: cannot run cargo build/clippy/test, npm install, vitest, eslint, tsc, or `cargo tauri icon` locally. Only `cargo fmt --check` (per crate) and global `npx prettier --check` are runnable offline. All heavier verification defers to CI on ubuntu-latest + windows-latest (routine `build` workflow). Do NOT un-gate the tauri-bundle workflow.
contribution_requirements: Keep the working end-to-end app green: do NOT regress the five surfaces, the single top-level onCoreEvent subscription, or existing command/event wiring. Preserve the privacy fail-closed guarantee (LocalOnly/Confidential force local, unoverridable). Keep serde IPC types in EXACT sync with the hand-mirrored TS in frontend/src/types/index.ts: #[serde(rename_all="camelCase")], per-variant camelCase on tagged enums, skip_serializing_if for empty Vec/Option. Do NOT bump version or cut a release. Do NOT implement Ollama/HF (empty-state placeholders only). Ship a segmented toggle, NOT a continuous slider. No new crate is expected (so no new CI steps).
key_patterns: Frontend: React function components, Zustand stores in src/state/ (each with applyCoreEvent reducer), typed IPC wrappers in src/ipc/commands.ts mirroring #[tauri::command] handlers, events via src/ipc/events.ts (onCoreEvent). classNames use a BEM-ish convention (app__sidebar, routing-mode__toggle, route-badge__model) but there is currently NO CSS FILE at all - Phase 7 introduces the design-token CSS system (import it in main.tsx). Rust: domain DTOs are the single source of truth in crates/domain/src/models.rs (re-exported by orchestrator-core); RoutingHint enum {PreferLocal,PreferQuality,PreferCheap,PreferSpeed} biases the auto policy; RoutingRequest is built in orchestrator-core/src/pipeline.rs run_turn and currently gets its hint ONLY from persona.routing_hint; privacy hard-constraint is enforced in auto_default.rs filter_candidates BEFORE any hint bias; SessionManager.mutate_conversation pattern for per-conversation field updates; ConversationRepo insert/update/row_to_conversation in persistence/src/repositories.rs; sqlx migrations additive. Tauri commands have an `_inner` variant for testability without live State. Prettier: semi true, doubleQuote, trailingComma all, printWidth 100, tabWidth 2, arrowParens always, LF. Vitest rule: after mutating a Zustand store outside act(), read the DOM via await findBy*/waitFor, never synchronous getBy.

directory_structure: hybrid-orchestrator/crates/{domain,secrets,persistence,providers,mcp-client,routing,orchestrator-core,tauri-app}. domain=leaf DTOs; persistence=sqlx SQLite + migrations; routing=RoutingPolicy engine (policy.rs, signals.rs, policies/auto_default.rs, PolicyRegistry); orchestrator-core=SessionManager + pipeline run_turn + events + permission; tauri-app=commands.rs (#[tauri::command] handlers, each with _inner testable body), lib.rs (invoke handler registration + event bridge), state.rs, icons/, capabilities/default.json (core:default least-privilege), tauri.conf.json. frontend/src: app.tsx (shell), main.tsx (entry), ipc/ (commands.ts, events.ts), state/ (zustand stores), features/{chat,model-selector,tool-manager,agent-editor,history}/, types/index.ts (hand-mirrored Rust DTOs), test-setup.ts.
